## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text by [法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2) Fǎxián is the Northern-Sòng version of the *Sukhāvatī-vyūha-sūtra*. The five extant Chinese translations — [T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060), [T0361](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0061), [T0362](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0062), the present T0363, and the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa assembly 5](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* — provide a uniquely rich comparative apparatus for the textual history of the *Larger Sukhāvatī*.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2) Fǎxián's Northern-Sòng imperial-bureau activity (982 – 1001 CE).

The Taishō text (T0363) is established on the standard apparatus.
